lemma phi_run : Runs (rotations c (TypeFace 1)) (readings (P.visitRatio hc) (TypeFace 1))
    (mean (visit P K hc)) (solo c (going P)) := by
  have hm p : mask 1 (fun i => pullLine P.patch i p)=hinges P 1 p := by
    unfold pullLine hinges; rw [mask1_scale]; rfl
  have he := patch_service (visit P K hc)
  change Runs (rotations c _) (readings (P.visitRatio hc) _) _ (fiber fun p : Site c => upAlias fun l : Site P.L =>
      (P.L.val:ℂ) • mask 1 (fun i => pullLine P.patch i (aliasAt (mon p) l))) at he
  simp_rw [hm] at he; exact he

proof_context.conclusion: The straight-link averaging `mean` of the visit step (patch weights) has as symbol `going`, the sum over aliases of `L` times `hinges` (`massFilter`, the b-factor to the stage power, times the `rail` factor r_l).

lemma root_gradient (v : form 0 f) : probe S *ᵥ (d 0 f *ᵥ v)=d 0 c *ᵥ centered S v := by
  funext ⟨x,i⟩
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := axisEquiv.surjective i
  rw [probe,Matrix.add_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,Pi.add_apply, mean_site]
  simp only [show axisEquiv.symm (coord a)=a from axisEquiv.symm_apply_apply _,coord_map,d_sites,psi_proj, mul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; unfold centered; abel

proof_context.conclusion: The frame response `probe` (`mean` plus `d 0 c * fixRoot`) sends the gradient `d 0 f v` to `d 0 c` of `centered S v`, i.e. Q d0 phi = d0 (phi o iota).

snippet.text: lemma K_kills : K H' * d 0 c=0 := by rw [K,Matrix.mul_assoc,d_d_vac,Matrix.mul_zero]

proof_context.conclusion: `K H'` annihilates `d 0 c`, so the reduced two-form energy ignores gradients.
